title: Almaty, Baku and the Shahdag Mountains
alt: Ridges of the Greater Caucasus above the Shahdag mountain resort
transport: Private transfers, private day tours and an internal flight

stops.name: Almaty
stops.subtitle: Almaty → Charyn Canyon and Kolsai
stops.accom: 6 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Well run hotel in the centre with a garden courtyard

activities.name: Almaty city sightseeing tour
activities.description: A private tour of the old capital, taking in the Monument of Independence, Panfilov Park and the wooden Ascension Cathedral.

activities.name: Medeu rink and Shymbulak ski resort
activities.match: Day Trip to Medeu Ice Skating Rink & Shymbulak Ski Resort
activities.description: A day up the Malaya Almatinka valley to the Olympic skating rink at Medeu, then by gondola to the Shymbulak slopes.

activities.name: Green Bazaar and the Rakhat chocolate factory
activities.match: Trip to Green Bazaar & Rakhat Chocolate Factory, Almaty
activities.description: The spice and dried fruit halls of the Green Bazaar, then the Rakhat factory whose chocolate every Kazakh family grew up on.

activities.name: Kok Tobe hill and the gondola
activities.match: Day Trip to Kok Tobe from Almaty
activities.description: The cable car up Kok Tobe for the whole city laid out below the mountains, with the Alley of Lovers at the top.

activities.name: Lake Issyk day tour
activities.match: Issyk Lake Day Tour From Almaty
activities.description: A private day east to the turquoise water of Lake Issyk, with the Saka burial mounds and the small site museum nearby.

activities.name: Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lake
activities.match: Day Trip to Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lake From Almaty
activities.description: A long day out to the red sandstone Valley of Castles in Charyn Canyon, then up to the forested shore of Kolsai lake.

program.name: Almaty
program.description: Six nights in the old Kazakh capital with five private day tours, from Shymbulak and Kok Tobe to Lake Issyk and Charyn Canyon.

stops.name: Baku
stops.subtitle: Baku → Gobustan
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Friendly hotel close to the walled Old City

activities.name: Baku Old City tour
activities.description: The walled Icherisheher with the Maiden Tower, the Shirvanshahs' palace, Fountain Square and the boating canals on the boulevard.

activities.name: Gobustan rock art and the mud volcanoes
activities.match: Gobustan National Park & Mud Volcanoes Tour from Baku
activities.description: Petroglyphs carved into the Gobustan boulders thousands of years ago, then the cold grey mud volcanoes bubbling on the flats.

program.name: Baku
program.description: Two nights on the Caspian for the walled Old City, the Gobustan rock carvings and the mud volcanoes.

stops.name: Shahdag
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Mountain hotel in the resort village at 1,700 metres

activities.name: Shahdag mountain ski resort
activities.match: Day Trip to Shahdag Mountain Ski Resort
activities.description: The largest resort in the Caucasus, with gondola lines running up bare ridges and an alpine coaster for the summer months.

activities.name: A free day in the mountains
activities.description: Skiing in winter or the gondola, zipline and walking trails in summer, all bookable on the spot at the resort.

program.name: Shahdag
program.description: Two nights high in the Greater Caucasus at the largest mountain resort in Azerbaijan, with a full day at leisure.

stops.name: Baku
stops.subtitle: Baku → Absheron
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Friendly hotel close to the walled Old City

activities.name: Absheron peninsula tour
activities.description: The Ateshgah fire temple, the Mardakan castle and Yanar Dagh, a hillside where escaping gas has burned for centuries.

program.name: Baku
program.description: A final night back on the coast after the Absheron fire temples and the Heydar Aliyev Centre.

expert.name: Aisha
expert.quote: Eleven nights and three very different landscapes: the Kazakh steppe, the Caspian oil coast and two nights up in the Caucasus.
expert.tip: Shahdag works in both seasons. Snow from December to March, and from June the gondola and the coaster run instead.

summary: Twelve days from the Kazakh steppe to the Greater Caucasus: six nights of private day tours out of Almaty, the Gobustan rock carvings and mud volcanoes from Baku, two nights high at Shahdag and the Absheron fire temples to finish.
included: Included: 11 nights with daily breakfast across Almaty, Baku and Shahdag; private airport transfers; private Almaty city sightseeing tour; Medeu and Shymbulak day trip; Green Bazaar and Rakhat chocolate factory trip; Kok Tobe day trip; Lake Issyk day tour; Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lake day trip; private Baku Old City tour; Gobustan National Park and mud volcanoes tour; Shahdag mountain resort day trip; Absheron peninsula tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; the Almaty to Baku internal flight; Kazakhstan and Azerbaijan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; laundry and personal expenses.
